---
title: Women's College Volleyball Roster Data Cleaning
---

```{r setup-root, include=FALSE}
# The notebook reads/writes repo-relative paths (data/, vb_rosters_*.csv);
# set the working directory to the repository root wherever the render runs.
if (!file.exists("data/teams.csv")) knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = "..")
```

```{r load-libraries, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
library(postmastr)
library(usdata)
```

This notebook processes and standardizes women's college volleyball roster data for a single season (set by `SEASON` below). The data requires extensive cleaning to standardize heights, positions, years, geographic information, and previous school names. Exploratory checks live in the **Data quality checks** section at the end.

## Setup and Configuration

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Configuration: change SEASON (e.g. "2027-28") and everything else follows
SEASON      <- "2026-27"
START_YEAR  <- as.integer(str_sub(SEASON, 1, 4))
SEASON_END  <- START_YEAR + 1L                                   # 2027
PREV_SEASON <- sprintf("%d-%02d", START_YEAR - 1L, START_YEAR %% 100L)  # 2025-26

# Scraper output lives in data/rosters_<SEASON>.csv; cleaned output follows
# the repo's vb_rosters_* naming.
INPUT_FILE   <- paste0("data/rosters_", SEASON, ".csv")
OUTPUT_FILE  <- paste0("vb_rosters_", SEASON, ".csv")
PREV_FILE    <- paste0("data/rosters_", PREV_SEASON, ".csv")
```

## Load Source Data

```{r load-data, message=FALSE}
# Load roster data and squish team names
vb_rosters <- read_csv(INPUT_FILE, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  mutate(team = str_squish(team))

stopifnot(all(vb_rosters$season == SEASON))
n_input <- nrow(vb_rosters)

# Load teams metadata (conference/division columns are joined only if present)
teams <- read_csv("data/teams.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  select(-any_of(c("url", "twitter", "stats_name", "private", "roster"))) |>
  distinct()

keep_cols <- intersect(c("ncaa_id", "team", "team_state", "conference", "division"),
                       names(teams))
if (setdiff(keep_cols, c("ncaa_id", "team")) |> length() > 0) {
  vb_rosters <- vb_rosters |>
    left_join(teams |> select(all_of(keep_cols)),
              by = intersect(c("ncaa_id", "team"), keep_cols),
              relationship = "many-to-one")
  cat("Joined team metadata columns:", setdiff(keep_cols, c("ncaa_id", "team")), "\n")
} else {
  cat("teams.csv has no conference/division data - skipping metadata join\n")
}
```

## Height Cleaning

The roster data contains heights in various formats (6'0", 6-0, 5'-2", 6′0″ with curly quotes). We standardize all heights to use hyphens (6-0) and create a total inches column for analysis.

```{r clean-heights}
# Source heights come as 6'0", 6' 0'', 5'-2", 6′0″, etc. Turn the feet mark
# (straight or curly apostrophe) into a dash AFTER dropping the inch marks and
# spaces — removing the apostrophe first would mangle 5'9" into "59".
vb_rosters <- vb_rosters |>
  mutate(
    height_clean = height |>
      str_replace_all("''", "") |>
      str_replace_all("″", "") |>
      str_remove_all("\"|\\s|(?i)height:") |>
      str_replace_all("[′']", "-")
  ) |>
  separate(height_clean, c("height_ft", "height_in"), sep = "-",
           extra = "merge", fill = "right", remove = FALSE) |>
  mutate(
    across(c(height_ft, height_in), \(x) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))),
    total_inches = height_ft * 12 + height_in,
    # Heights outside a plausible range are parse errors, not players
    total_inches = if_else(between(total_inches, 55, 84), total_inches, NA_real_)
  )

# Check the formats that did not make it into the plausible range
vb_rosters |> filter(!is.na(height_clean), is.na(total_inches)) |>
  count(height_clean, sort = TRUE)
```

## Position Cleaning

Volleyball positions come as long names ("Outside Hitter", "Middle Blocker", "Defensive Specialist"), abbreviations (OH, MB, DS), and slash combinations (OH/DS, L/DS, MB/RS). We standardize to a canonical code set — OH (outside), MB (middle), S (setter), L (libero), DS (defensive specialist), OPP (opposite), RS (right side), PH (pin), UT (utility) — with a mapping table for the known formats and a token fallback for everything else.

```{r clean-positions}
# Existing mapping from raw position strings to canonical codes
positions_cleaned <- read_csv("data/cleaned_positions.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  select(-count) |>
  distinct(position, .keep_all = TRUE)

# Fallback for variants the mapping lacks: spell out the long forms first,
# then map each remaining token to a code and rebuild in order.
token_map <- c(
  S = "S", SET = "S", SETTER = "S", SETTERS = "S",
  OH = "OH", O = "OH", OUTSIDE = "OH",
  MB = "MB", M = "MB", MID = "MB", MIDDLE = "MB", MH = "MB",
  DS = "DS", D = "DS", DEF = "DS", DEFENSE = "DS", DEFENSIVE = "DS",
  L = "L", LIB = "L", LIBERO = "L",
  RS = "RS", R = "RS", RIGHT = "RS",
  OP = "OPP", OPP = "OPP", OPPOSITE = "OPP",
  PIN = "PH", PH = "PH", UT = "UT", UTL = "UT", UTILITY = "UT"
)

fallback_position <- function(x) {
  map_chr(x, \(p) {
    if (is.na(p)) return(NA_character_)
    p <- p |>
      str_to_upper() |>
      str_replace_all(c(
        "OUTSIDE HITTER" = "OH", "MIDDLE BLOCKER" = "MB",
        "DEFENSIVE SPECIALIST" = "DS", "RIGHT-SIDE HITTER" = "RS",
        "RIGHT SIDE HITTER" = "RS", "RIGHT-SIDE" = "RS",
        "RIGHT SIDE" = "RS", "PIN HITTER" = "PH", "PIN-HITTER" = "PH"
      ))
    tokens <- unname(token_map[str_split_1(p, "\\s*[/-]\\s*")])
    if (anyNA(tokens)) return(NA_character_)
    paste(tokens, collapse = "/")
  })
}

vb_rosters <- vb_rosters |>
  mutate(position = str_squish(position),
         position = na_if(position, ""), position = na_if(position, "N/A")) |>
  left_join(positions_cleaned, by = "position", relationship = "many-to-one") |>
  mutate(
    position_clean = coalesce(cleaned_position, fallback_position(position)),
    position_full  = position_clean
  ) |>
  select(-cleaned_position) |>
  # Split combined positions (e.g., "OH/DS")
  separate(position_clean, c("primary_position", "secondary_position"),
           sep = "/", extra = "merge", fill = "right")

# Check position distribution
vb_rosters |> count(primary_position, sort = TRUE)
```

## Year Classification Cleaning

We standardize year classifications to: Freshman, Sophomore, Junior, Senior, Graduate Student, Fifth Year, Sixth Year. We also track redshirt status separately.

```{r clean-years}
# Exact-match lookup for the known formats (one row per key)
years_cleaned <- read_csv("data/years_cleaned.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  rename(year_clean = `year-clean`) |>
  filter(!is.na(year_clean)) |>
  distinct(year, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  select(-count)

# Pattern fallback for everything the lookup misses (FRESHMAN, 2nd Year, Jr. (3rd), ...)
year_from_pattern <- function(x) {
  x <- x |> str_to_upper() |> str_squish() |> str_remove("^ACADEMIC |^R-|^RS-?|^RED ")
  case_when(
    str_detect(x, "^GR|GRAD")                       ~ "Graduate Student",
    str_detect(x, "SIXTH|SEVENTH|6TH")              ~ "Sixth Year",
    str_detect(x, "FIFTH|5TH")                      ~ "Fifth Year",
    str_detect(x, "^FR|FRESH|1ST|FIRST|^1$")        ~ "Freshman",
    str_detect(x, "^SO|SOPH|2ND|SECOND|^2$")        ~ "Sophomore",
    str_detect(x, "^JR|JUNIOR|3RD|THIRD|^3$")       ~ "Junior",
    str_detect(x, "^SR|SENIOR|4TH|FOURTH|^4$")      ~ "Senior",
    TRUE                                            ~ NA_character_
  )
}

# Class years in the source can also be graduation years (2029 / '29)
grad_year_class <- c("Freshman", "Sophomore", "Junior", "Senior")
grad_year_map <- tibble(
  year = c(as.character(SEASON_END + 3:0), paste0("'", (SEASON_END + 3:0) %% 100)),
  grad_year_clean = rep(grad_year_class, 2)
)

vb_rosters <- vb_rosters |>
  left_join(years_cleaned, by = "year", relationship = "many-to-one") |>
  left_join(grad_year_map, by = "year", relationship = "many-to-one") |>
  mutate(
    year_clean = coalesce(year_clean, grad_year_clean, year_from_pattern(year)),
    redshirt = coalesce(
      redshirt,
      as.numeric(str_detect(str_to_upper(year), "REDSHIRT|^R-|^RS|^RED "))
    )
  ) |>
  select(-grad_year_clean)

# Check year distribution
vb_rosters |> count(year_clean, sort = TRUE)
```

## High School and Previous School Cleaning

Some records list high schools in the previous_school column. We separate these and backfill missing high school data from previous roster years.

```{r clean-schools}
# Some records list high schools in the previous_school column
hs_pattern <- "HS|H\\.S\\.|High School"

previous_school_is_hs <- vb_rosters |>
  filter(is.na(high_school) | high_school == "",
         !is.na(previous_school), str_detect(previous_school, hs_pattern)) |>
  pull(previous_school) |>
  unique()

vb_rosters <- vb_rosters |>
  mutate(
    hs_clean = if_else((is.na(high_school) | high_school == "") &
                         previous_school %in% previous_school_is_hs,
                       previous_school, high_school),
    previous_school_clean = previous_school,
    # Clear previous_school when it is really the high school (or junk: "NA",
    # "none", …) — the scraper's own hygiene rules leave a few behind
    previous_school_clean = if_else(
      previous_school_clean %in% c("", "NA", "N.A.", "none", "None") |
        previous_school_clean == hs_clean,
      NA_character_, previous_school_clean)
  )

# Backfill missing high schools from last season's file (same player, same team)
if (file.exists(PREV_FILE)) {
  previous_hs <- read_csv(PREV_FILE, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
    filter(!is.na(high_school), high_school != "") |>
    distinct(ncaa_id, name, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
    select(ncaa_id, name, prev_high_school = high_school)

  vb_rosters <- vb_rosters |>
    left_join(previous_hs, by = c("ncaa_id", "name"), relationship = "many-to-one") |>
    mutate(
      backfilled = is.na(hs_clean) & is.na(previous_school_clean) & !is.na(prev_high_school),
      hs_clean = coalesce(hs_clean, prev_high_school)
    )

  cat("Backfilled", sum(vb_rosters$backfilled, na.rm = TRUE), "high school records from", PREV_FILE, "\n")
  vb_rosters <- select(vb_rosters, -prev_high_school, -backfilled)
} else {
  cat("No previous season file", PREV_FILE, "- skipping high school backfill\n")
}

# Blank-string high schools are missing, not real values
vb_rosters <- vb_rosters |>
  mutate(hs_clean = if_else(is.na(hs_clean) | str_squish(hs_clean) == "", NA_character_, hs_clean))
```

## Geographic Data Cleaning

We clean hometown/homestate data to standardize state abbreviations and identify international players.

```{r clean-geography}
# Standardize hometown format
vb_rosters <- vb_rosters %>%
  mutate(
    hometown_cleaned = hometown %>%
      str_to_upper() %>%
      str_replace_all("\\.", "") %>%
      str_replace("/.*", "") %>%
      str_replace("\\.$", "") %>%
      str_replace(",", ", ") %>%
      str_squish()
  )

# Create extended state dictionary for postmastr
states_non_standard <- pm_append(
  type = "state",
  input = c("SD.", "MASS", "CALIF", "MICH", "NEB", "IND", "MINN", "ORE", "OHIO",
            "FLA", "MISS", "TENN", "ARIZ", "KAN", "ALA", "OKLA", "WIS", "ILL",
            "WASH", "ARK", "COLO", "NEV", "CONN", "WISC", "WVA", "DEL", "WYO",
            "CALI", "LOUIS", "VIRG", "MONT", "PENN", "TEX", "KANS", "NEBR",
            "IDA", "COL"),
  output = c("SD", "MA", "CA", "MI", "NE", "IN", "MN", "OR", "OH", "FL", "MS",
             "TN", "AZ", "KS", "AL", "OK", "WI", "IL", "WA", "AR", "CO", "NV",
             "CT", "WI", "WV", "DE", "WY", "CA", "LA", "VA", "MT", "PA", "TX",
             "KS", "NE", "ID", "CO"),
  locale = "us"
)

dict <- pm_dictionary(type = "state", case = c("title", "upper", "lower"),
                     append = states_non_standard)

# Identify addresses and parse states using postmastr
vb_rosters <- vb_rosters %>%
  pm_identify(var = "hometown_cleaned")

parsed <- vb_rosters %>%
  pm_prep(var = "hometown_cleaned", type = "street") %>%
  pm_state_parse(dict)

# Join parsed results
vb_rosters <- vb_rosters %>%
  left_join(parsed, by = "pm.uid") %>%
  separate(hometown, c("hometown", "homestate"), sep = ",", extra = "merge", fill = "right") %>%
  mutate(
    homestate = str_trim(homestate),
    homestate = str_replace(homestate, "\\.", ""),
    homestate = case_when(
      is.na(abbr2state(homestate)) ~ homestate,
      TRUE ~ abbr2state(homestate)
    )
  )

# Handle special state cases
vb_rosters <- vb_rosters %>%
  mutate(
    pm.state = case_when(
      homestate %in% c("Hawai'i", "O'ahu") ~ "HI",
      homestate == "Ken" ~ "KY",
      homestate %in% c("Caif", "Cal", "Calfiornia", "Califonia") ~ "CA",
      homestate %in% c("Illi", "IIl", "Illnois") ~ "IL",
      homestate == "Min" ~ "MN",
      homestate == "N C." ~ "NC",
      homestate == "NMex." ~ "NM",
      homestate == "Oreg" ~ "OR",
      homestate %in% c("US.V.I", "USVI") ~ "USVI",
      homestate == "Ver" ~ "VT",
      homestate == "Was" ~ "WA",
      homestate == "WS" ~ "WI",
      homestate == "NYC" ~ "NY",
      TRUE ~ pm.state
    )
  )
```

## Country Identification

The country is the last piece of the hometown unless a US state was parsed. Variant spellings, provinces and regions are standardized below. Volleyball rosters draw heavily from Canada, Brazil, Europe and Australia, so province/region variants are more common than in the basketball data.

```{r clean-countries}
# Extract potential country from last part of hometown
vb_rosters <- vb_rosters %>%
  mutate(
    country = if_else(!is.na(pm.state), "USA", NA_character_),
    # Puerto Rico and US territories carry state-style codes
    country = if_else(pm.state %in% c("PR", "GU", "VI", "USVI"), "USA", country),
    # last comma-separated piece of the hometown (NA when hometown is missing/empty)
    temp = str_trim(str_extract(hometown_cleaned, "[^,]+$")),
    temp = if_else(temp %in% c("NA", ""), NA_character_, temp),
    # known nation names are kept as-is; anything else falls through to temp for standardization
    country = coalesce(country, temp)
  )

# Standardize country names
vb_rosters <- vb_rosters %>%
  mutate(
    country = case_when(
      # US state codes that slipped through as the last piece are not countries
      !is.na(country) & country %in% state.abb ~ "USA",
      # Canadian provinces
      country %in% c("BC", "BRITISH COLUMBIA", "ALBERTA", "ALTA", "AB",
                     "ONTARIO", "ON", "QUEBEC", "QUÉBEC", "QUE", "QC",
                     "MANITOBA", "SASKATCHEWAN", "NOVA SCOTIA", "NS", "CN") ~ "CANADA",
      # Australian states
      country %in% c("VICTORIA", "SOUTH AUSTRALIA", "WESTERN AUSTRALIA",
                     "TASMANIA", "QUEENSLAND", "AUSTRAILA", "AU", "AUS") ~ "AUSTRALIA",
      country %in% c("NZ") ~ "NEW ZEALAND",
      # UK variations
      country %in% c("GREAT BRITAIN", "ENGLAND", "ENG", "UK", "WALES",
                     "SCOTLAND", "NORTHERN IRELAND", "EAST MIDLANDS") ~ "UNITED KINGDOM",
      country %in% c("IRELAND", "IRL") ~ "IRELAND",
      # Other common variants
      country %in% c("HAWAI'I", "HAWAII") ~ "USA",
      country %in% c("PUERTO RICO") ~ "USA",
      country %in% c("SWEEDEN") ~ "SWEDEN",
      country %in% c("CZECHIA") ~ "CZECH REPUBLIC",
      country %in% c("DR") ~ "DOMINICAN REPUBLIC",
      country %in% c('THE NETHERLANDS', 'NETHLERLANDS', 'NOORD HOLLAND') ~ 'NETHERLANDS',
      country %in% c('MÉXICO') ~ 'MEXICO',
      country %in% c("SÉNÉGAL") ~ "SENEGAL",
      country %in% c('DR CONGO', 'DEMOCRATIC REPUBLIC OF CONGO', 'CONGO') ~ 'DEMOCRATIC REPUBLIC OF THE CONGO',
      country %in% c("TURKIYE", "TÜRKIYE") ~ "TURKEY",
      TRUE ~ country
    )
  ) %>%
  select(-temp)
```

## Final Data Preparation

```{r final-cleanup}
vb_rosters_final <- vb_rosters |>
  select(-pm.id, -pm.uid, -pm.type, -pm.address, -any_of(c("backfilled", "count"))) |>
  select(-height) |>   # raw height lives on in height_clean/total_inches
  rename(
    hometown_clean = hometown_cleaned,
    state_clean = pm.state,
    country_clean = country
  ) |>
  distinct() |>
  # Same player listed twice on one roster (e.g. partial scrapes): keep the more complete row
  mutate(.filled = rowSums(!is.na(across(everything())))) |>
  slice_max(.filled, n = 1, by = c(ncaa_id, team, name, jersey), with_ties = FALSE) |>
  select(-.filled) |>
  relocate(team, ncaa_id, season, jersey, name, position, height_clean, year, hometown, homestate,
           high_school, previous_school, url,
           height_ft, height_in, total_inches, position_full,
           primary_position, secondary_position, year_clean, redshirt,
           hs_clean, hometown_clean, state_clean, country_clean,
           previous_school_clean,
           any_of(c("team_state", "conference", "division"))) |>
  arrange(ncaa_id, jersey)

cat("Dropped", n_input - nrow(vb_rosters_final), "duplicate player rows\n")
stopifnot(
  "rows were lost beyond duplicate players" = nrow(vb_rosters_final) == n_distinct(vb_rosters$ncaa_id, vb_rosters$team, vb_rosters$name, vb_rosters$jersey),
  "wrong season" = all(vb_rosters_final$season == SEASON)
)
```

## Write Output

```{r write-output}
write_csv(vb_rosters_final, OUTPUT_FILE, quote = "all", na = "")

cat("Final dataset written to", OUTPUT_FILE)
cat("\nFinal statistics:")
cat("\n- Total players:", nrow(vb_rosters_final))
cat("\n- Teams:", n_distinct(vb_rosters_final$ncaa_id))
cat("\n- Transfer players:", sum(!is.na(vb_rosters_final$previous_school_clean)))
cat("\n- International players:", sum(vb_rosters_final$country_clean != "USA", na.rm = TRUE))
```

## Transfer Analysis by Conference

```{r transfer-analysis}
if (all(c("conference", "division") %in% names(vb_rosters_final))) {
  conference_transfers <- vb_rosters_final %>%
    filter(division == "I") %>%
    group_by(conference) %>%
    summarise(
      total_players = n(),
      total_transfers = sum(!is.na(previous_school_clean)),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(transfer_pct = total_transfers / total_players * 100) %>%
    arrange(desc(transfer_pct))

  print(head(conference_transfers, 20))
} else {
  cat("No conference/division data in teams.csv yet - add those columns to run\n")
  cat("this analysis\n")
}
```

## Data quality checks

Run these after a render; anything that prints rows needs a look.

```{r check-coverage}
# Teams in teams.csv with no roster this season
teams |>
  anti_join(distinct(vb_rosters_final, ncaa_id), by = "ncaa_id") |>
  select(ncaa_id, team, any_of(c("conference", "division", "team_state")))
```

```{r check-year-missing}
# Teams with players but no class year
vb_rosters_final |>
  group_by(ncaa_id, team) |>
  summarize(n = n(), no_year = sum(is.na(year_clean)), .groups = "drop") |>
  filter(no_year == n)
```

```{r check-missing}
# NA counts for the cleaned columns
vb_rosters_final |>
  summarize(across(c(total_inches, position_full, year_clean, state_clean, country_clean,
                     hs_clean, previous_school), \(x) sum(is.na(x)))) |>
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "column", values_to = "n_missing")

# Source values that did not clean
vb_rosters_final |> filter(!is.na(height_clean), is.na(total_inches)) |> count(height_clean, sort = TRUE)
vb_rosters_final |> filter(!is.na(position), is.na(position_full)) |> count(position, sort = TRUE)
vb_rosters_final |> filter(!is.na(year), is.na(year_clean)) |> count(year, sort = TRUE)
```

```{r check-high-school-na}
# Teams with at least one player missing high_school, worst first
teams_missing_hs <- vb_rosters_final |>
  filter(country_clean == "USA" | is.na(country_clean)) |>
  group_by(ncaa_id, team) |>
  summarize(players = n(), missing_high_school = sum(is.na(hs_clean)), .groups = "drop") |>
  filter(missing_high_school > 0) |>
  mutate(pct_missing = round(missing_high_school / players * 100, 1)) |>
  arrange(desc(pct_missing), desc(missing_high_school))

teams_missing_hs
```

```{r check-stale-roster}
# Teams whose roster is a copy of last season's (same urls, names and class
# years). Returning players should move up a class, so any team here means the
# scrape fell back to an old page: exclude it from the scraper output.
if (file.exists(PREV_FILE)) {
  stale_norm_url <- \(x) x |> str_to_lower() |> str_remove("^https?://") |>
    str_remove("^www\\.") |> str_remove("/$")
  stale_key <- \(df) df |>
    transmute(ncaa_id = as.character(ncaa_id), name, year_clean,
              url = stale_norm_url(url)) |>
    filter(!is.na(url), !is.na(year_clean))
  prev_rows <- read_csv(PREV_FILE, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
    transmute(ncaa_id = as.character(ncaa_id), name,
              year_clean = year_from_pattern(year),
              url = stale_norm_url(url)) |>
    filter(!is.na(url), !is.na(year_clean))
  stale_key(vb_rosters_final) |>
    left_join(prev_rows, by = c("ncaa_id", "url"), suffix = c("", "_prev")) |>
    group_by(ncaa_id) |>
    summarize(players = n(), shared = sum(!is.na(name_prev)),
              identical = sum(name == name_prev & year_clean == year_clean_prev,
                              na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
    filter(identical >= 5, identical >= 0.9 * players) |>
    left_join(teams |> transmute(ncaa_id = as.character(ncaa_id), team), by = "ncaa_id")
}
```

```{r check-duplicates}
# Same player listed twice on one roster
vb_rosters_final |> count(ncaa_id, team, name, jersey) |> filter(n > 1)
```

```{r check-countries}
missing_countries <- vb_rosters_final |> filter(is.na(country_clean))
if (nrow(missing_countries)) {
```
